description: This file defines the ProjectOverviewForm class, a form processor for creating and editing project overview data in the Goteo application. It includes form field definitions, constraints, and helper methods for choices related to project attributes.

classes.name: ProjectOverviewForm
classes.description: A form processor class for managing project overview forms, including validation constraints and form fields.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for a specified form field, including conditional constraints based on form state.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds and configures the form fields with labels, constraints, choices, and attributes necessary for project overview editing.

methods.name: getLanguagesAsChoices
methods.description: Provides a list of language choices for form selection, retrieved from the Lang class.

methods.name: getCurrenciesAsChoices
methods.description: Provides a list of currency choices for form selection, retrieved via the Currency class.

methods.name: getSocialCommitmentsAsChoices
methods.description: Returns a list of social commitment options for the form.

methods.name: getProjectScopesAsChoices
methods.description: Provides a list of project scope options.

methods.name: getSdgsChoices
methods.description: Returns a list of SDG options with icons for selection.

methods.name: getProjectGlobalSocialCommitments
methods.description: Generates HTML displaying social commitments and related SDGs for the project.
